csv_project_name: AE Services for Baraga CF - Maint Equipment Storage Building
csv_scope_of_work: The Michigan Department of Corrections (MDOC) is seeking proposals from qualified architectural / engineering firms to provide professional services for the design, bidding and administration for construction of a maintenance equipment storage building at the Baraga Correctional Facility (AMF). This project includes sufficient preliminary design to review potential onsite building locations with the project team and performing field reconnaissance to vet prospective sites, considering utilities, soil characteristics, topography and fit within travel corridors. The desired structure is envisioned to be a steel-framed and -paneled building on an appropriate concrete/masonry foundation with a floor slab.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Soil Testing, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Stormwater, Urban Studies/Planning/Design, Architecture Services
